findings.suggested_fix: Add an S-3 or S-4 AC at 04:00 local on Sat 28 Nov 2026 (22:30 UTC Fri). Give the doctor different slots and bookings on Saturday and Friday, and expect Saturday's booked, free and next free values.
findings.text: The time-zone boundary (REQ-3) is tested for listing (S-1 AC2) and the link (S-6 AC2), but not for booked/free/next-free counts. If counts used the UTC date at 04:00 local, they would come from Friday's slots and every AC would still pass.

findings.suggested_fix: State concrete tile counts and Next appointments entries for a seeded dataset, or name the existing tests that must keep passing unchanged.
findings.text: S-7 AC2/AC3 compare against 'the same values as before this change' and name no expected values, so the observable check depends on a pre-change baseline the AC does not define.

rubric_items.reason: All 19 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-19) are traced by at least one story; there are no assumed REQs.
Stories are small and each has a clear outcome. S-1 bundles listing, the time-zone rule, Inactive exclusion and the empty state, but they share one outcome.

ACs are Given/When/Then and most discriminate: the cancelled slot, PAST vs FREE, start == now, name tie-break, and the UTC+05:30 date shift for listing and links. Counts are not tested at the time-zone boundary.
Values are illustrative test data or come from the intent; UTC+05:30 and 22:30 UTC are derived inline from Asia/Kolkata (REQ-3). The 28 Nov 2026 Saturday weekday is correct.
Clear and consistent terms. The body restates ACs in shortened form that drops some details (for example 'Active' in S-1 AC2), so it could drift from the front matter.
